#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static const bool _DEBUG = false;

class MyScanner {
public:
    std::istream& in;
    std::string buffer;
    std::istringstream st;

    MyScanner(std::istream& _in) : in(_in) {}

    std::string next() {
        while (!(st >> buffer)) {
            if (!(std::getline(in, buffer))) {
                return "";
            }
            st.clear();
            st.str(buffer);
        }
        return buffer;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return std::stoi(next());
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return std::stoll(next());
    }

    double nextDouble() {
        return std::stod(next());
    }

    std::string nextLine() {
        std::string line;
        std::getline(in, line);
        return line;
    }
};

static MyScanner scan(std::cin);
static std::ostream& out = std::cout;

int debugCount = 0;
void debug(const std::string& msg) {
    if (_DEBUG && debugCount < 200) {
        out << msg << "\n";
        out.flush();
        debugCount++;
    }
}

int main() {
    int N, M, pow;
    int* counts;
    int*** dp;

    N = scan.nextInt();
    M = scan.nextInt();
    if (N < M) {
        int temp = N;
        N = M;
        M = temp;
    }
    pow = 1 << M;
    counts = new int[pow];
    dp = new int**[N];
    for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
        dp[y] = new int*[pow];
        for (int i = 0; i < pow; i++) {
            dp[y][i] = new int[pow];
            std::fill(dp[y][i], dp[y][i] + pow, -1);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < pow; i++) {
        counts[i] = __builtin_popcount(i);
        dp[0][i][0] = counts[i];
    }

    int minSpiders = INT_MAX;
    for (int y = 0; y < N - 1; y++) {
        for (int i = 0; i < pow; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < pow; j++) {
                if (dp[y][i][j] == -1) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < pow; k++) {
                    int mask = (i | (i << 1) | (i >> 1) | j | k);
                    if ((mask & (pow - 1)) == (pow - 1)) {
                        int val = dp[y][i][j] + counts[k];
                        if (dp[y + 1][k][i] == -1 || dp[y + 1][k][i] > val) {
                            dp[y + 1][k][i] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < pow; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < pow; j++) {
            int mask = (i | (i << 1) | (i >> 1) | j);
            if (dp[N - 1][i][j] != -1 && (mask & (pow - 1)) == (pow - 1)) {
                minSpiders = std::min(minSpiders, dp[N - 1][i][j]);
            }
        }
    }

    out << (N * M) - minSpiders << "\n";

    // Cleanup
    for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
        for (int i = 0; i < pow; i++) {
            delete[] dp[y][i];
        }
        delete[] dp[y];
    }
    delete[] dp;
    delete[] counts;

    return 0;
}
